command.name: security key-manager health policy modify
command.description: This command modifies the health monitor policy

parameter.name: keystore-type
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the keystore-type of the health monitor policy to be updated.

parameter.name: enabled
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify if the health monitor is enabled.

parameter.name: manage-volume-offline
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify if the health monitor can automatically offline the volumes if the key manager cannot be reached.

example.p: The following example updates the AWS 'keystore-type' health monitor policy "enabled" and "manage-volume-offline" values.
example.screen: cluster-1::> security key-manager health policy modify -keystore-type AWS -enabled false -manage-volume-offline false
